ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all natural-person ultimate beneficial owners, directors, officers, and authorized signatories against the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, OFAC SDN list, EU and UK consolidated financial sanctions lists, and Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU) domestic lists; PEP categorization (foreign, domestic, and international-organization PEPs plus family members and close associates) per the AML/CFT Act 2024 with enhanced due diligence required for PEPs; risk-tier validated as Low_Risk_Standard for the ISIC 7310 advertising/SEO agency business; ongoing transaction monitoring and a minimum five-year record-retention obligation for all CDD and KYC documentation.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.registration_and_licensing_note: No sectoral statutory license is required for App Store Optimization, multilingual organic search, or SEO localization agency services under Vanuatu law; however, the International Company must at all times maintain a licensed resident registered agent and registered office in Port Vila, and the agent must conduct AML/CFT vetting before accepting the engagement.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Company Registry - online name availability search and reservation via VFSC e-services portal (https://www.vfsc.vu) submitted exclusively through a licensed registered agent
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company name must be in Latin-script English or French characters; Bislama is not a statutory filing language; foreign-language names must be transliterated phonetically into Latin script; the name must terminate in a permissible suffix under the International Companies Act, namely 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Corp', 'Incorporated', 'Inc', 'Société Anonyme', or 'S.A.'; punctuation and spacing must follow standard romanization rules; no non-Latin script is accepted in the registered name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A reserved name may be renewed once for a further 30 days upon written application and payment of the renewal fee before the initial reservation expires; failure to incorporate within the reservation window forfeits priority. If VFSC rejects the proposed name on grounds of similarity to an existing name, the licensed registered agent may file a written administrative appeal with the VFSC Board within 14 calendar days of the refusal notice, attaching search evidence and a comparative analysis of distinguishing elements (spelling, geographical qualifiers, or trade-mark coexistence). Where the rejection arises from a prohibited or sensitive token, the applicant must first obtain the relevant ministerial consent or sectoral eligibility certificate (e.g., Minister responsible for VFSC, Vanuatu Financial Services Authority, or Vanuatu Reserve Bank for banking/insurance terms) and resubmit the name through the registered agent; no further administrative fee is charged for a single resubmission arising from a consent condition.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as a substitute for the statutory registered office; every International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Vanuatu through a VFSC-licensed Company and Trust Service Provider, where the statutory registers (members, directors, and beneficial owners) are physically kept; virtual/back-office administrative arrangements are tolerated only for behind-the-scenes coordination and cannot replace the registered agent's address or the statutory record-keeping location.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: low, approximately 5-10% annual probability of an unannounced on-site inspection for a low-risk standard IC in the ISIC 7310 category. VFSC and VFIU hold statutory inspection powers and may conduct unannounced examinations of the registered agent's premises and inspection of UBO records; direct on-site inspection of the offshore IC's own operating premises is rare because the commercial activity is performed wholly outside Vanuatu, but any migration of substantive activity into Vanuatu would trigger business-licensing and tax-residency reassessment.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222], Republic of Vanuatu, ss. 5-14 (incorporation), s. 21 (registered agent/office), ss. 36-45 (directors and secretary)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association together with Form 1 (Application for Incorporation) lodged with the VFSC
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None required; International Companies Act [Cap. 222] allows incorporation with one or more shares of no par value, no statutory paid-up minimum and no escrow account mandate
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the proposed allotment and subscription of 1,000 ordinary shares of no par value to the subscriber, as recorded in the register of members, be and is hereby ratified and confirmed. RESOLVED that the registered office of the Company be established at the office of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu, and the registered agent is hereby approved and retained. RESOLVED that the subscriber be and is hereby appointed the sole director of the Company, with plenary powers to open banking accounts, execute service agreements, and delegate operational matters. RESOLVED that the director is authorized to cause the Company to file all post-incorporation statutory returns with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engage Licensed Registered Agent and Reserve Corporate Name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-approved registered agent in Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct a VFSC-licensed agent to conduct a name availability search and file a name reservation request for the intended international company name. Provide certified passport copies and proof of residential address of the subscriber; sign the agent engagement and consent letter confirming the registered office address in Vanuatu.
required_dossiers: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement)
Registered agent engagement and consent letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or flagged, promptly submit 2-3 alternative names or amend the proposed name to remove prohibited words, then re-submit the reservation to VFSC for expedited review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in accordance with the International Companies Act [Cap. 222], reflecting no par value shares, limited liability, and the objects of international advertising and digital marketing services. Execute the documents before a notary and affix corporate seal if applicable.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as director and secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC queries any constitutional clause, file a memorandum of amendment within 5 business days or adopt a revised document and pay the nominal amendment fee before re-lodging.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, International Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent submits the executed Memorandum and Articles, Form 1, director and secretary consents, and the VFSC fee payment. The registry verifies compliance and issues the Certificate of Incorporation, typically within 1-2 business days.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is rejected or queried, correct the identified deficiencies within 14 days using VFSC's resubmission procedure; an expedited re-filing can be requested by the registered agent with a priority fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Certificate of Incorporation and Post-Incorporation Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry and the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Collect the Certificate of Incorporation, then instruct the agent to open the statutory registers: register of members, register of directors and secretary, and register of charges. Issue share certificates to the subscriber and record allotment in the register of members.
required_dossiers: Share certificates and share transfer forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains clerical errors, submit a written request to VFSC for rectification under the International Companies Act, supported by the original certificate and statutory declaration of error.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Activate Registered Office and Open Banking Facilities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent and corporate banking institution in Vanuatu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm the registered office at the agent's Port Vila address and obtain an updated registered office certificate. Commence bank account onboarding with Wise B2B or Payoneer using corporate documents; file beneficial ownership particulars with VFSC if requested.
required_dossiers: Director's passport and proof of address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank or payment processor requests enhanced due diligence, provide a notarized statement of source of funds and a corporate structure chart; re-submit within 10 business days to avoid closure of the application.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable - office-based professional services; no manufacturing license required; municipal business license may apply only if a physical office is operated in Port Vila Municipality
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: International Company Certificate of Incorporation (no separate statutory operating license mandated for ISIC 7310 digital marketing services)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - administrative and digital services with no physical development, construction, or industrial discharge
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial effluent or VOC thresholds apply; office waste must be handled under Port Vila Municipality waste management bylaws, and e-waste must be disposed through licensed recyclers if applicable

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Office premises must obtain a fire safety clearance from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services for workplace occupancy; structural load inspection for standard office use is not separately required; workplace conditions must comply with the Employment Act [Cap. 160] health and safety provisions covering ventilation, electrical safety, and ergonomic workstations

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Department (VRCD), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; e-services portal: https://www.customs.gov.vu. International Company registration and supervision: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An offshore foreign entity forming a Vanuatu International Company (IC) obtains a Certificate of Incorporation from the VFSC through a licensed registered agent. No statutory tax identification number (TIN) is required unless the IC carries on a taxable activity in Vanuatu. If a TIN or VAT registration is needed, the entity must submit Form VAT-1 to the VRCD with the certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles, registered office/registered agent evidence, director and shareholder details, and annual turnover projections. The VRCD issues a VAT/TIN certificate. An IC conducting only offshore ASO/SEO digital services holds the VFSC registration number as its primary corporate identity and has no Vanuatu direct tax filing obligation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu has no corporate income tax, no check-the-box regime, and no hybrid mismatch election under domestic law. The IC is statutorily exempt from income tax, VAT on offshore activities, and exchange controls. Voluntary VAT registration is available for persons making taxable supplies in Vanuatu, but an IC’s offshore ISIC 7310 digital services are outside the Vanuatu VAT net. Foreign tax authorities may independently classify the IC for their own tax purposes; such classifications do not alter Vanuatu tax status.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 of taxable supplies in any 12-month period; non-residents supplying taxable services in Vanuatu may be required to register without regard to threshold. An International Company performing only offshore services has no VAT registration obligation.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No mandatory continuous transaction control or real-time fiscal clearance regime exists. VAT invoices may be issued in paper or electronic form and must contain the prescribed particulars. There is no government API invoice clearance, no digital fiscal stamping, and no prior online approval of invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods physically exported from Vanuatu within the statutory timeframe and services supplied to non-residents for use wholly outside Vanuatu qualify for the 0% VAT rate. For ISIC 7310 ASO/SEO localization services, the supplier must establish that the recipient is a non-resident, the service is performed or delivered outside Vanuatu, and the consideration is paid from outside Vanuatu. Export services are substantiated by contracts, invoices, delivery evidence, and non-resident declarations.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit advice
Executed service agreement and delivery/performance evidence for offshore digital services
VAT export invoice and customer non-resident declaration
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRCD may audit zero-rated export claims retrospectively. Deficient substantiation or fraudulent export zero-rating triggers clawback of refunded VAT, penalty tax up to double the amount, interest, deregistration, and disqualification from future refunds. Criminal liability may include fines up to VUV 10,000,000 and/or imprisonment. Directors and registered agents may be held jointly and severally liable. False customs declarations attract separate forfeiture and penalty provisions under the Customs Act.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) as the central bank and monetary authority with supervisory oversight over licensed banks and payment systems; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) exercises supplementary regulatory supervision over non-bank financial institutions and offshore service providers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Republic of Vanuatu operates a fully liberalised foreign-exchange regime. The Vatu (VUV) is freely convertible for both current and capital account transactions. There are no exchange-control permit requirements, no statutory limits on the purchase or sale of foreign currency, and no restrictions on profit remission, dividend distribution, repayment of shareholder loans, or capital repatriation. The RBV exercises prudential oversight to ensure anti-money laundering (AML) and counter-financing-of-terrorism (CFT) compliance, but it does not impose economic or quantitative controls. For an International Company (IC) structured as a tax-exempt non-resident status entity, the practical retainment of USD, EUR, AUD, or other major currencies is unrestricted. Profit remittance is effected through customary corporate bank wire transfers subject to standard customer due diligence and source-of-funds documentation, rather than sovereign approval.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory requirement exists in Vanuatu for the mandatory surrender of export proceeds or for the conversion of foreign-currency receipts into Vatu. An International Company may retain export and service revenues indefinitely in foreign currency accounts with RBV-licensed commercial banks or transfer such proceeds offshore at will. There is no mandatory timeline, no prescribed conversion ratio, and no central bank accounting of individual trade receipts.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: Medium-High. Offshore digital electronic-money institutions (EMIs) such as Wise Business and Payoneer are the contracted target payment rails for this ASO/SEO localization agency. Neither is licensed as a deposit-taking institution in Vanuatu; therefore they cannot provide VUV-denominated accounts or benefit from RBV depositor protection. The legal constraint is that these EMIs operate under foreign money-transmitter and e-money licences, and they may internally flag Vanuatu-incorporated ICs as tax-haven vehicles requiring heightened review. The practical mitigation is to open multi-currency accounts with the EMI as a non-Vanuatu regulated entity, use those accounts for affiliate disbursements, client collections in USD/EUR/GBP, and cross-border vendor payments, while maintaining a primary operational account with an RBV-licensed bank for VUV settlement, legal invoicing, and higher-value counterparty verification.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance of all directors is not a blanket statutory prerequisite. RBV-licensed commercial banks generally permit remote onboarding for International Companies when the following conditions are satisfied: certified true copies of passports, proof of business address, a registered-agent corporate certificate, and completed bank-specific legal entity forms. In practice, a video conference interview with signatories is required. The interview verifies identity, governance authority, and source of funds. In-person attendance is occasionally mandated for politically exposed persons (PEPs), persistent discrepancies in submitted documentation, or where the offshore jurisdiction of the remitting bank is deemed high-risk.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial owner is a politically exposed person or resides in a high-risk jurisdiction flagged by FATF.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid unexpired passport; government-issued proof of residential address; independent bank reference letter from a recognised regulated financial institution; sworn source-of-wealth declaration; comprehensive curriculum vitae or public-profile evidence; a PEP-specific risk assessment narrative explaining the source of funds, political exposure, and the absence of corruption nexus; and notarised board resolutions authorising the account and transaction purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The company is an International Company in a tax-haven jurisdiction with no physical office or employees in Vanuatu.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered agent certificate issued under the Vanuatu International Companies Act; executed professional services agreements with named clients; invoices and payments ledger covering search-engine optimisation (SEO), app store optimisation (ASO), and multilingual localisation services; Google Play Console and Apple App Store Connect developer dashboards evidencing active app-management activity; platform analytics showing revenue origination; bank-issued test statements; and a detailed business plan demonstrating the operational substance provided through the registered agent and digital infrastructure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Frequent high-volume cross-border payments originating from multiple unrelated jurisdictions to the Vanuatu IC's account.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master service agreements and per-client contracts; beneficial-owner identification data of all major counterparties; payment schedule with reference numbers linking each inbound wire to a specific invoice; reconciliation statements prepared in accordance with the International Company's internal records; a notarised declaration confirming that no physical goods transit Vanuatu; and a board-approved AML controls manual, including a payment-screening policy.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Immediate injection of equity capital or shareholder loan soon after incorporation without an operational revenue history.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised board resolution approving share allotment and bank account mandate; shareholder loan agreement or subscription agreement; certified source-of-funds bank statements covering at least the preceding six months; identity proof of the transferor; an independent legal opinion confirming the capital transaction is lawful under the Vanuatu International Companies Act and the Foreign Exchange and Banking Act; and a statement from the registered agent confirming good standing.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The compliant routing for inbound capital injection into the Vanuatu International Company is a SWIFT MT103 single-customer credit transfer initiated by the beneficial owner or lending institution to the company's designated corporate account at an RBV-licensed bank. The wire instruction must clearly reference the purpose code corresponding to 'Share Capital Injection' or 'Intercompany Shareholder Loan', and the sub-category should align with the IMF Balance of Payments direct-investment or other-investment classification. The remitting bank must provide the full legal name, address, and account number of both sender and recipient. The receiving RBV-licensed bank will verify the board resolution appointing the account signatories, the beneficial-owner declaration, and the source-of-funds details if the remittance exceeds USD 10,000. No RBV exchange-control permit is required, but the transfer must pass international sanctions screening, particularly the UNSC and OFAC lists, substantiated by the bank's internal controls.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlement for service-based trade from this ASO/SEO localization agency is executed primarily through the SWIFT MT103 electronic credit transfer for vendor payments, contractor settlements, and licensing fees. For high-frequency, low-value payments, the designated offshore EMI rails (Wise Business and Payoneer) are used for automated batch disbursements without substantial documentary friction. Commercial Letters of Credit are not used because digital service transactions do not generate shipping documents; however, for contingent strategic acquisitions or a substantial service milestone, a documentary standby credit may be structured under UCP600 with a Port Vila branch of a domestic commercial bank. All outbound payments must reference the underlying invoice number, be screened for OFAC/UN/EU sanctions, and be supported by retained contracts and vendor AML profiles.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX spot contracts (VUV/USD, VUV/EUR, VUV/AUD, and other major cross pairs) executed through an RBV-licensed bank.
Outright FX forwards with tenors of up to 12 months for major currency pairs, documented under ISDA or local bank master agreements.
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on the VUV (permissible, though counterparty appetite is limited given the absence of exchange controls).
Cross-currency interest rate swaps available for matched principal flows in USD, EUR, AUD, and JPY, executed through offshore ISDA counterparties.
Vanilla FX options for hedging long-term revenue streams and protecting profit conversion margins.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return lodgment under Section 72, International Companies Act Cap 222
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Port Vila
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after each annual anniversary of incorporation; no fixed calendar date, rolling anniversary-based deadline.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of 10% of the annual government fee per month or part-month overdue; continued default beyond 2 months allows VFSC to issue a strike-off notice under Section 74 and remove the company from the register administratively; each defaulting director additionally risks a fine up to VUV 100,000 (approx USD 900).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership (UBO) Confirmation Statement delivered to the registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent in Port Vila as statutory custodian of beneficial ownership records
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Must be certified by directors concurrently with the Annual Return, before the registered agent will process the annual renewal; no separate government filing date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit an accurate UBO confirmation prevents the agent from filing the Annual Return, triggering late-fee accrual and potential strike-off; a false or misleading declaration can attract penalties up to VUV 500,000 (approx USD 4,500).

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit applies to Vanuatu International Companies. An independent audit becomes mandatory only if directors or shareholders adopt a special resolution requiring audited financial statements or if the VFSC directs an audit in the course of an investigation.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No prescribed statutory framework; accounting records must accurately explain transactions and permit determination of financial position. IFRS or a simplified accrual-basis framework is generally accepted, and financial statements are not required to be filed with the VFSC.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every International Company must maintain current beneficial ownership information with its registered agent in compliance with VFSC AML/CFT directives. Each share transfer must be recorded in the Register of Members within 30 days and any resulting UBO change notified to the registered agent before the next annual confirmation. The annual confirmation is a directors' declaration that the agent-held UBO data remains accurate; Vanuatu maintains no public UBO register.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members and Share Transfers
Minute Book of Directors' and Shareholders' Meetings

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800 - 1,500 per annum for a VFSC-licensed registered agent and registered office in Port Vila
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required; market estimate USD 2,500 - 5,000 if a voluntary certified audit is commissioned

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no estate tax, and no withholding tax on any payments to non-residents. International Companies are wholly tax-exempt on worldwide income, subject only to annual VFSC registration fees and statutory filing obligations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Vanuatu International Company Annual Return (filed electronically through the VFSC Online Portal administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission; physical filing through a licensed registered agent is also accepted).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 30 days after each anniversary date of incorporation, unless an extension is granted by the VFSC Registrar. The registered agent must submit the Annual Return and pay the applicable VFSC annual fee simultaneously.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name of the International Company as shown in the Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact English name registered with VFSC; no tax identifiers are relevant.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unique company number issued by VFSC at incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Obtain from Certificate of Incorporation or the registered agent's file.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3: Registered Office Address in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical street address of the registered office maintained by the licensed registered agent in Port Vila.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cannot be a P.O. Box; must be a physical address and must be supplied by the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, address, and contact details of the Vanuatu-licensed registered agent appointed by the International Company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent must be a VFSC-licensed service provider; a non-resident director cannot act as registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: List of current directors and officers, with names, addresses, nationality, and passport/ID numbers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted; provide certified passport copies and utility bills for each individual.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: List of shareholders and their respective shareholdings; nominee shareholders, if any, must be identified.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ownership is fully allowed; bearer shares are prohibited. Beneficial ownership details are held by the registered agent under AML rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the company is not carrying on prohibited activities and has complied with the International Companies Act and Economic Substance (if applicable).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Sign electronically or by the registered agent under power of attorney.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file the Annual Return within the statutory deadline triggers a late filing penalty equal to 10% of the annual license fee, escalating daily at VUV 1,000 until filing. Persistent default (over three months) can result in VFSC-initiated deregistration, strike-off, and loss of limited liability protection.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreements in force. As such, no domestic DTA relief procedure, TRC issuance mechanism, or treaty-based claim exists. When a foreign jurisdiction imposes withholding tax on dividends, interest, or royalties paid from that foreign source to the Vanuatu entity, any relief must be pursued under the foreign jurisdiction's domestic law and any applicable foreign tax treaty. A Vanuatu Tax Residency Certificate is generally not obtainable because the International Company, while tax-exempt, is not a resident for treaty purposes under Vanuatu law.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 0% on Vanuatu-source royalty and interest paid to non-residents. Treaty rate: Not applicable due to the absence of DTA network. In practice, if the Vanuatu entity receives royalties from overseas, the payer may be subject to foreign WHT, and no Vanuatu credit or refund mechanism exists.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No formal transfer pricing documentation threshold exists in Vanuatu under the International Companies Act. Because Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, the domestic TP regime is effectively inapplicable. In practice, intercompany transactions with foreign related parties should still be commercially documented to substantiate the entity's economic substance and to withstand scrutiny in the source jurisdiction under that jurisdiction's TP rules.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019 applies to International Companies carrying on prescribed 'relevant activities': banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters operations, holding company activities, intellectual property holding, and distribution and service centres. An ASO/SEO localization agency engaged purely in online marketing services does not ordinarily fall within these categories. However, if it operates a physical distribution or service centre in Vanuatu, it must satisfy the economic substance requirement (i.e., prudent management, adequate physical presence, full-time employees, and sufficient local expenditure) and file an annual Economic Substance Return with the VFSC. Non-IP service activities outside these categories are exempt from substance reporting.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion Through False Exemption Claims
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Misrepresenting the Vanuatu tax-exempt status to foreign tax authorities, or using the International Company as conduit in an artificing scheme to avoid tax in a foreign jurisdiction without genuine economic activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment up to 12 years under the Vanuatu International Companies Act for fraud; mandatory deregistration of the company by VFSC; confiscation of corporate records; administrative fine up to VUV 2,000,000. Additional exposure arises under foreign anti-avoidance rules, including economic substance legislation in OECD member states.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners may be personally liable for the underlying foreign taxes and penalties through 'piercing the corporate veil'. Courts may issue travel bans, freezing orders on personal assets, and a personal liability order for all corporate debts. Any director found to have knowingly made false declarations may be barred from acting as a director in any Vanuatu company for up to five years and may face imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a dormant shell without any real office, employees, or business activity while being used as a booking vehicle for invoices, licenses, or assets related to a relevant commercial activity; failure to respond to VFSC substance information requests.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act, fines range from VUV 500,000 to VUV 5,000,000 for substance mismatches; the registrar may also strike off the company and notify the Ministry of Finance, triggering foreign exchange restrictions. Shareholders may be directed to surrender all assets derived from the shell arrangement.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face civil restitution orders for the value of benefits received, personal exposure to VFSC enforcement costs, and a statutory ban of up to 10 years on managing any international company. If the shell is used to commit fraud, directors are jointly and severally liable to creditors and may be extradited under mutual legal assistance treaties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure of the non-resident directors and beneficial owners to supply accurate KYC documentation, concealment of a politically exposed person, or conducting client money flows through the company without a licensed money services business, particularly using payment corridors such as Wise B2B or Payoneer without proper AML transaction monitoring.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Vanuatu Financial Services Commission imposes administrative penalties of VUV 1,000,000 to VUV 10,000,000; criminally, the Anti-Money Laundering Act 2011 provides imprisonment up to 15 years and/or a fine up to VUV 20,000,000. The company's bank accounts and PSP relationships are subject to freeze orders by the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and beneficial owners are criminally liable where they knew or ought to have known of tainted funds. Civil consequences include personal confiscation of proceeds, jointly and severally with other perpetrators, and prohibition from holding bank mandates or trustee licenses. Travel bans and extradition to the requesting state are routinely sought.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The company itself, or through its branding as an SEO/ASO agency, collects deposits, issues payment instruments, or operates a payment gateway for foreign clients without obtaining a VFSC banking/investment business license, or undertakes insurance/fiduciary activities beyond the agency scope.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: An International Company carrying on a licensed activity without a license is liable to a fine not exceeding VUV 5,000,000 and forfeiture of all income derived from the unlawful activity. VFSC may also impose an additional disciplinary penalty of VUV 50,000 per day for continuing breach and may deregister any intermediary holder.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for restitution to affected clients and for any penalties imposed by VFSC. The court may impose a custodial sentence of up to 7 years for knowingly operating a financial business without a license; in practice, directors' passports are impounded pending resolution of the proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file the annual return or pay the VFSC annual fee within the statutory 30-day window after incorporation anniversary, despite repeated reminders from the registered agent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Automatic late penalty of VUV 25,000 plus VUV 1,000 per day of delay; after 90 days, VFSC may strike the company off the International Companies Register. Struck-off companies lose legal capacity, assets may be forfeited to the Government, and a restoration fee of VUV 150,000 plus all arrears is due before reinstatement.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly allow continued default are personally liable for the company's VFSC fees and penalties. When the company is struck off, its bank accounts freeze and PSP funds are trapped; directors can be sued by creditors and counterparties in civil proceedings for fraudulent conveyance, effectively piercing the corporate veil.
